versions.changelog: Bird refugee box; Official MCP Registry + llms.txt/mcp.json discovery; wider posting-verb frontmatter; clarify @daydreamnationtechlabs/clawpost (not clawpost.dev).
Facebook groups are post-only for groups the human already belongs to. Removed discover/join growth-loop language. Replaced lower-ban-risk with desktop Chrome / no debugger.

Clawpost 2.1.0 changelog:

- Added Instagram posting support (including media uploads).
- Added Reddit comment/reply via browser (no Reddit API key needed).
- Introduced MCP (Model Context Protocol) support with Streamable HTTP and OAuth for Claude, ChatGPT, and compatible agents.
- Expanded media capabilities: support for large file uploads via signed URLs.
- Updated onboarding: Chrome extension now pairs automatically with Google sign-in.
- Improved instructions and table of available endpoints/platforms.

Version 1.1.8

- Expanded authentication section to clarify that the Claw Post API key is not embedded in the skill file and should be set via environment variables only.
- Improved security explanation: clarified that no social platform credentials or OAuth tokens are used or exposed, only a Claw Post API key.
- Rewrote and expanded extension instructions, including more guidance on safe setup and extension permissions.
- Added reminders not to paste keys into skill files or version control.
- General text cleanup for clarity and less risk of credential mishandling.

- Updated skill metadata to include `requires` with required environment variables.
- Refined environment variable naming to use `CLAWPOST_API_KEY` (was previously escaped).
- Minor formatting and typographic consistency improvements throughout documentation.
- No changes to endpoints, features, or core functionality.

clawpost 1.1.6 Changelog

- Improved description and clarity in documentation for setup steps and platform security.
- Enhanced language on credential privacy, browser session, and workflow simplicity in the Why Claw Post section.
- Adjusted escape characters in sample code and group search result fields for consistency and accuracy.
- No changes to source code or endpoints; changes limited to documentation and instructional text.

- No changes in functionality; this version contains no file updates.
- All existing features and documentation remain the same as the previous version.

clawpost 1.1.4

- Added new configuration file: clawhub.json
- No changes to functionality or API; this update is for platform or metadata configuration only.

Clawpost v1.1.3 Changelog

- Updated API base URL to https://api.clawpost.net (from a previous regional variant).
- Added explicit environment variable configuration with a required `CLAWPOST_API_KEY`.
- Improved and clarified prerequisites and authentication steps, highlighting security and privacy details of the browser extension.
- Enhanced documentation structure with a new "Why Claw Post" section and clearer multi-platform, group, and media-posting instructions.
- Minor fixes and updated external documentation and extension links.

Clawpost — Secure social posting for AI agents via real browser extension. Post to X, LinkedIn, Facebook (feed + groups), TikTok (coming soon). Search & join Facebook groups. No platform API keys or credential sharing. Human-like behavior with retries.
Built for OpenClaw marketing teams — autonomous posting, group discovery, low ban risk.
Let your agents publish to X without official API keys, credential sharing, or fragile scripts. One API call. Real browser sessions. Reliable delivery.
